email.subject1: a signal play for Solutions by Text
email.body1:
Keith, saw Solutions by Text go live with the first RCS financial-services customer and embed FinText into Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

New product surface like that usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Solutions by Text off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Keith, quick follow-up for Solutions by Text.

After growth financing, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Solutions by Text needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Keith, last bit of proof for Solutions by Text.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer fintech firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Keith, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Rolling out a first-of-its-kind RCS product is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your fintech motion? I'll tailor it to Solutions by Text either way.
